items.q: Who owns the code and IP?
items.a: You do. Full IP transfers on final payment; we keep nothing but the right to say we built it.
A deposit books your slot, then you pay per accepted milestone. Each milestone has a defined scope; the balance for it is due when it ships and you sign it off. No timesheets, no open-ended invoices.
A structured handover: your code in your accounts, documentation, and a defined post-ship window for fixes at no charge. If you want us to keep building, the retainer picks up where the Sprint ends.
The deadline is written into the agreement and payment is tied to accepted milestones. If a build slips on our side, you have not paid for the milestone that slipped. The risk sits with us, not you.
Each package states exactly what is included. Anything outside that scope is a clear, priced change order agreed in writing before we build it, so the timeline you signed off on holds.

The studio: orchestrated AI agents do the engineering, inside human-owned architecture, code review and security gates. Senior judgment decides what to build, how it is architected and secured, and what is ready to ship.

items.q: What happens after I book a call or send a brief?
items.a: A 30-minute diagnostic call, free. Then a written fixed-price proposal within two business days. If it fits, a deposit and a kickoff date, and the build starts.
